versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

- Initial release of "assembly-one-step-clip" skill.
- Converts each authorized assembly still and seller-supplied step fact into a single short assembly step video.
- Follows step-by-step process: stills inspection, labeled step plan, capability check, live price quote, user confirmation, then generate clips.
- Clips are delivered in step order, never stitched or edited together.
- All operations use the bundled MCP client; REST/OpenAPI is not used.
- Detailed recovery and update mechanisms for robust and safe delivery.
